# HANGUK SKIN

> HANGUK SKIN (Hanguk Skin Private Limited) is an Indian company based in Gurugram, Haryana. It is the official importer and distributor of genuine Korean beauty brands in India, serving retailers, chains and online marketplaces.

## What HANGUK SKIN does
- Imports Korean beauty brands only, through official channels. No grey-market or parallel imports.
- Handles CDSCO import registration, India-compliant labelling and documentation.
- Stores stock in a bonded FTWZ warehouse in India.
- Distributes to retail stores, chains and online marketplaces across India.
- Supports the brands it carries with online, offline and digital marketing.
- HANGUK SKIN is printed as the importer on every pack. Partners can request import registration, invoices and batch details.

## Categories
Skincare, sun care, cleansers, sheet masks, makeup.
